notes: Evaluation of the main pipeline (AgentClinic two-turn protocol). Trajectories of each system come from `python -m scripts.run_grpo generate --split <split> --output <file>` on the same D1 histories. Collaboration states and standalone accuracy are read from the trajectories (judged diagnoses). The models, prompts and case split come from run_config. The final evaluation split is TEST, which no stage before it touches.

serl.adapter_notes: path of the evaluated adapter, e.g. outputs/serl/<run_id>/iter2/adapter; checkpoint = its checkpoint_id

behavior_judge.notes: The behavior judge of the label pipeline (RQ2 class definitions with both sides' information in view); its prompt is built in src/agentclinic/candidates.py.

matched_continuation.k_notes: same K as the Effectiveness labels
